description: This file defines the 'Dish' result class for a database schema, including its columns, relationships, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities, deleting associated records, and preparing data for editing.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Dish
classes.description: A schema class representing a dish, including its properties, relationships to meals, recipes, ingredients, tags, and methods for recalculating ingredient quantities and preparing data for editing.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates ingredient quantities based on a new number of servings and updates related items.

methods.name: update_items_and_delete
methods.description: Removes ingredients from purchase list, deletes ingredients and the dish itself within a transaction.

methods.name: for_meals_dishes_editor
methods.description: Prepares a hashref of dish data including the associated meal's date for editing purposes.
